blocks.text: BACOLOD CITY, NEGROS OCCIDENTAL, Philippines — A total of 1,544 voter applications were processed across the Negros Island Region (NIR) on Tuesday, Nov. 10, as the Commission on Elections (Comelec) officially reopened nationwide voter registration for the 2028 national and local elections. The Comelec NIR reported that Negros Occidental processed the highest number with 856 applications, comprising 423 males and 433 females. Negros Oriental followed with 651 total applications consisting of 301 males and 350 females, while Siquijor registered 37 applications made up of 23 males and 14 females.
